errors.evidence: The description omits the title of the plot, "ViT, ImageNet1k", which provides crucial context about the model and dataset being visualized.
The y-axis range is from 10^-3 to 10^0, not 10^1. 10^0 equals 1, while 10^1 equals 10.
The orange line starts at the top of the y-axis, at 10^0 (which is 1), not near the bottom at 10^-3.

errors.text_span: and increases to approximately 0.85 at 37700 training steps
errors.evidence: The orange line decreases significantly from its starting point of 1 and stabilizes around a value of approximately 0.6-0.7. It does not increase.

errors.text_span: increases to approximately 0.9 at 37700 training steps
errors.evidence: The blue line does not simply increase. It experiences a very sharp, rapid increase at the beginning of the training steps and then stabilizes, fluctuating around a value just under 1.0 for the remainder of the steps. Describing it as a simple increase to its final value misses this key dynamic.
